label: extension

args.subject: Child seat availability at your London location
args.body:
Hello New Car Rental,

Could you please let me know whether child seats are available for car rentals at your London location? If so, please share the available seat types, any additional charges, and whether they need to be reserved in advance.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed New Car Rental at **support@newcarrental.co.uk**, the address listed in a customer review, asking whether they offer child seats in London, along with seat types, charges, and advance-booking requirements.
